RSK-001.title: DL-016 Metadata-Block Shift — Pack A Section E (58 Certified)
RSK-001.severity_rationale: Learner-safety risk. Certified items in active delivery pool. Metadata-block ExplanationWrong fields describe a DIFFERENT item's choices than the content block the learner sees. Learners who select wrong answers receive feedback about a completely unrelated topic.
RSK-001.status: OPEN — not addressed by S804 clone archival
RSK-001.detected_by: Build-Time AI Verification (Session 5, expanded Session 64, re-confirmed S803/S804)

affected_items.archived_note: 17 items Archived — including some with DL-016 shift. Since Archived, no learner impact. P1-E-055 (Archived) confirmed DL-016: CC=D is actually B, EC describes access recertification not inventory counts.
affected_items.shift_pattern: Metadata-block ChoiceA-D text advertises previous QID's topic (systematic +1 offset in 5-item rotation groups)

learner_impact.mechanism: When a learner selects a wrong answer on an affected item, the rendering engine reads ExplanationWrong from the metadata block (Block 1), which carries stale +1-offset text from the previous rotation-group neighbor. The learner sees: 'Why you got this wrong' text that describes a completely different topic.
learner_impact.example: P1-E-055 metadata EW fields describe access recertification (P1-E-056's topic), but the learner answered P1-E-055 about physical inventory counts. Feedback is semantically unrelated.
learner_impact.discovery_mechanism: The content block (learner-facing stem + choices) is internally consistent. The metadata block (learner-facing explanations) is +1 shifted. The gap is invisible during MCQ-only review because stems/choices look correct — it manifests only when a learner submits a wrong answer and reads the distractor explanation.
learner_impact.pct_of_section: 77.3% of Pack A Section E Certified items
